scope.downstream_consumer: Living Region regional metabolism, land, food, labour and transition scenarios

fields.description: Physical fuel availability or supply-loss parameter.
fields.notes: Energy Model contains price, production, refinery and consumption indicators but no validated fuel-availability index.

fields.description: Direct fuel price increase parameter for Living Region scenarios.
fields.notes: The listed CPI growth series are not a diesel price series and must not be substituted automatically.

fields.description: Diesel price multiplier relative to a documented baseline.
fields.notes: Requires a diesel-specific price series and baseline definition.

fields.description: Physical fertilizer availability or supply-loss parameter.
fields.notes: No fertilizer supply/availability series is published by the current Energy Model contract.

fields.description: Fertilizer price multiplier relative to a documented baseline.
fields.notes: Do not infer from oil or natural-gas CPI without a fertilizer-specific pass-through model.

fields.description: Transport cost multiplier used by local food and freight scenarios.
fields.notes: Freight activity and energy-price changes are contextual signals, not a calibrated cost multiplier.

fields.description: Import-price pressure applied to food and essential goods.
fields.notes: Food-price indexes provide upstream pressure evidence; Living Region must retain its scenario multiplier until pass-through is calibrated.

fields.description: Purchasing-power pressure related to energy and essential costs.
fields.notes: These indicators can inform the proxy but cannot be collapsed into the existing coefficient without a documented model.

fields.description: Trade competition or export-restriction scenario parameter.
fields.notes: No direct trade-competition estimate is produced.

fields.description: Share of upstream pressure transmitted to households.
